Through:

 Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar, Judge.

The petitioner has challenged FIR No. 9/2023 for offence under Sections 498A, 323,
506 IPC registered with Police Station Women's Kupwara along with the charge sheet emanating there from which is stated to be pending before the court of Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Sogam,
Kupwara.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the dispute between petitioner and the complainant i.e, respondent No. 3 has been settled and in this regard, the parties have entered into compromise vide deed dated 17.08.2024.
Issue notice to the respondents subject to taking of necessary steps by the petitioner within one week.
List on 08.11.2024.
In the meantime, the proceedings in the impugned challan pending before the court of Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Sogam Kupwara shall remain stayed.
(Sanjay Dhar) Judge SRINAGAR 13.09.2024 Aasif Tawfeeq Ahmad Ganie vs Union Territory Of J&K & Ors on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151155657/
